0.why: Prob8Core.cc:49 hands this jack to cp.updateClock, whose SchmittTrigger at clockPhase.h:58 goes high at 1.5V and low at 0.5V; each rising edge steps the count that Prob8Core.cc:24 reads modulo 8 to pick the step. Prob8Core.cc:10 derives from CoreProcessor, which reads channel one only

1.why: Prob8Core.cc:52 hands this jack to cp.updateReset, whose SchmittTrigger at clockPhase.h:60 goes high at 1.5V and low at 0.5V; clockPhase.h:26-27 zero wholeCount on a rising edge, returning the sequence to the first step

comment: The random number is drawn between 0 and 0.99 (Prob8Core.cc:26), so a knob at the top always fires. The maker's manual says the gates are 0-8v with a fixed 50% pulse width, which Prob8Core.cc:28 and Prob8Core.cc:62 bear out.
